title: Plan View multi-user shared highlight merge
description:
Plan View highlights now union-merge across users on the same tenant instead of overwriting each other. GET returns the caller's row merged with a shared __shared__ row; PUT merges the save into both so every user's marks accumulate. Desktop restore stays local; this ships the live API behavior on BASE/SaaS.

Who is affected: anyone using PipeSync Plan View with more than one account on the same company/tenant.
changeLog: GET /pipesync/plan-view: user payload ∪ __shared__ (union by annotation id, prefer richer/pdf-vp1)
PUT /pipesync/plan-view: merge into user row and __shared__ (no blind replace)
